rootCauseAnalysis: The panel that overflows is 'feedback' (the event feed / creature story panel), whose own font size (HudFontSizes.FeedbackFontSize = 12) was already at the floor before this Issue and was not raised. It overflows because the panels sharing its column grew taller above it: roster (10->12), the inspector heading (unchanged, 13), the inspector body (11->12), and — the largest single contributor — the eight legend rows (8->12, a jump the coordinator named in advance as roughly a one-and-a-half-times height increase, HudFontSizes.cs:LegendFontSize doc comment). The side column's total height is fixed by the viewport; every pixel the legend and roster/inspector gained above 'feedback' is a pixel 'feedback' no longer has below them. This is not a font-size defect in 'feedback' itself, it is the same fixed-height column the legend's own history (#52, #222, #86) already treats as scarce.
